description: Use this when the user wants to browse supported cities before searching. Returns city names, slugs, country codes, and product counts.

country.description: Optional country code or country name filter.

format.description: Response shape. 'json' returns structured records; 'text' returns the same content rendered as a short narrative paragraph for chat surfaces.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for human-readable fields (e.g., 'en', 'fr-FR'). Defaults to English when omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of cities to return (1-50). Defaults to 50 when omitted.

name: list_cities
